limitations: CC-X01 is a measurement corpus only. It does not select semantics, change an oracle, authorize production code, or close OD-003.

The cases are isolated single modules. Import resolution, duplicate adoption, expressions, graph admission, artifact grammar, themed vocabulary, packaging, and release behavior remain outside this slice.

The LinkML child loads the exact retained universal wheels under the calling Python interpreter. This report does not claim replay of the complete selected Linux OCI and CPython tuple or every retained transitive dependency.
OntologyRegistry is bound by the exact implementation digest recorded in observations.json. Any implementation change requires a fresh measurement rather than silent reuse of these bytes.
